completion: A correct clarification, uncertainty, rejection or conflict can complete its specified task. Server succeeded is not semantic completion.

denominators.primary: all attempted tasks including failed, interrupted and pending tasks
denominators.secondary: explicit graded/structurally valid subsets, reported separately
denominators.unattempted: report planned but not attempted separately

ungraded_policy: Keep completion and semantic grades null; report only a confirmed-completion lower bound when partial grades exist. Never grade by keyword matching or server task success.
human_and_model: Separate human/model grades, coverage and uncertainty. Human coverage may be zero and must be disclosed.
historical_policy: Independent synthetic development set. No frozen holdout, previous outputs, failures, scores, grants or ledgers were used to tune it. A final quality set must be fresh after debugging.
live_policy: No live executor or authorization is provided by this packet. Zero-call preflight is preparation only. No automatic retries, fallback, judge calls, approvals or remote GitHub access.
